instruction: Candid cinematic film still, medium shot. In a concrete underground parking garage, the woman in the black bucket hat (R2) stands in the center, smiling as she holds up the leg of the laughing woman in the black beanie (R1) on the left. On the right, the woman in the olive vest (R3) stands with her arm wrapped around the shoulder of the woman in the black bucket hat (R2), laughing joyfully. The group is captured in a playful, dynamic pose. Cool overhead fluorescent lighting casts a soft glow on them against the dark garage interior.
